entities.summary: Ramchandra Vidyabagish was an Indian lexicographer and Sanskrit scholar who published the first monolingual Bengali dictionary, Bangabhashabhidhan, in 1817. He was a key figure in the development of the Brahmo Sabha and played a significant role in the Bengali Renaissance. Vidyabagish taught at the Vedanta College established by Raja Rammohun Roy and later at Sanskrit College from 1827 to 1837. His contributions to Sanskrit and Bengali literature have had a lasting impact on the cultural and linguistic landscape of India. He was initiated into Brahmo Samaj in 1843 by Debendranath Tagore, who would later become a prominent figure in Indian nationalism. Vidyabagish's legacy extends beyond his academic work, as he was a prominent figure in the intellectual and cultural movements of his time. His emphasis on education and intellectual freedom continues to inspire scholars and intellectuals to this day.
